peperbus.name: Peperbus
peperbus.slogan: A pepper mill that has been grinding out hours since 1482.
peperbus.line: Built between 1463 and 1482, the tower lost its top to fire in 1815; its 51-bell carillon is among the largest in the Netherlands.

sassenpoort.name: Sassenpoort
sassenpoort.slogan: The gate where Zwolle still greets you the way it did in 1409.
sassenpoort.line: Built in 1409, the gate holds 13 stained-glass coats of arms, and cars have been banned from passing beneath it since 2010.

schokland.name: Schokland
schokland.slogan: An island with no sea left, and a church that remembers.
schokland.line: Schokland, abandoned in 1859 and left landlocked in 1942, became in 1995 the first World Heritage Site in the Netherlands.

kampen.name: Kampen's IJssel Gates
kampen.slogan: Hanseatic gates, and a town famous for its wise fools.
kampen.line: Kampen joined the Hanseatic League in 1441, and three of its medieval city gates still stand.

fundatie.name: Museum de Fundatie
fundatie.slogan: A ceramic cloud has landed on a neoclassical palace of justice.
fundatie.line: The cloud-shaped roof gallery added in 2013 is clad in some 55,000 three-dimensional ceramic tiles.

waive_area_cap: Zwolle's three defining sights all stand in the compact Binnenstad
